水墨Ink wash

宣纸、墨、几样国画颜料,一笔一笔按笔顺画出来,空着的地方也是画。只定死五样,其余按场景定:技术框图、产品首屏、诗词、四季、武侠、电影、壁纸、发布会都能画。48 张图例,48 张会动。Rice paper, ink and a few Chinese pigments, painted stroke by stroke; the empty paper is part of the picture. Only five things are fixed, everything else follows the scene: architecture diagrams, product pages, poems, seasons, wuxia, film, wallpapers, launches. 48 figures, 48 of them animated.

看 48 张图例See 48 figures 它怎么懂你How it learns you

出图模型分三次画远景、中景、近景,scripts/layers.mjs 抠成透明层,各层按不同速度移动,层间夹一道雾。The image model painted far, middle and near separately; scripts/layers.mjs cut them into transparent layers that drift at different speeds with mist between.

定死的五样The five fixed things

五样都在,怎么画都是水墨With all five, it is ink wash whatever you paint

黑白、彩色、技术图、壁纸都还是水墨;少一样就不是了。每一样都写了「没有它会怎样」。Black and white or colour, diagram or wallpaper — still ink wash. Lose one and it is not. Each comes with what breaks without it.

宣纸Paper暖白带纤维;深色版是磁青纸配泥金,另画不反相。Warm fibrous white; at night indigo paper with gold, repainted, never inverted.没有它:纯白像打印稿,反相像底片Without it: print-out white, or a negative
水墨Ink & water墨分五色,颜色透明、一层层叠,不平涂。Five tones of ink; see-through colour in layers, never flat.没有它:平涂像剪纸,硬渐变像 PPTWithout it: paper cut-outs or slide gradients
提按Pressure起笔斜切,收笔出锋,墨少出飞白,落定晕开。Slanted start, pointed exit, dry brush as ink runs out, a bleed once it lands.没有它:等宽线就成了图标Without it: even lines, an icon
留白Empty paper水、天、雾不画;字写在留白里。Water, sky and mist are left unpainted; words live there.没有它:画满了像油画Without it: an oil painting
印 · 字Seal & brush毛笔标题,至少一方朱印当句号。Brush lettering, at least one red seal as the full stop.没有它:像没画完Without it: unfinished
先问场景,再动笔Scene first, brush second

同一支笔,五种场景五种画法One brush, five scenes, five ways

动笔前问四件事:在哪看、读者要得到什么、动不动多长、有没有必须准确的字数线。答案落到下面一组,就知道留白多少、颜色怎么用、谁来画。Ask four things first: where it is seen, what the reader should get, whether it moves and for how long, and whether any words, numbers or lines must be exact. The answer lands in one row below.

越用越懂你It learns your taste

你挑一张、说一句,它就记住Pick one, say a word, and it remembers

口味学习由公共的 design-taste 做,所有设计风格共用。它按场景分开记:技术图爱淡、壁纸爱浓互不干扰;你在铅笔画里说「字太小」,水墨这边也听见;给它一张喜欢的画,它量出留白和设色;每张按口味画的图右下角有一方小印,点开看它为什么这样画。Taste learning is the shared design-taste, used by every design style. It keeps scenes apart (faint diagrams and heavy wallpapers do not fight), hears what you said about pencil drawings, measures space and colour from a picture you like, and puts a small seal on every drawing it adjusted — click it to see why.

自己试一下:挑你喜欢的那张Try it: pick the one you like

这个场景现在的口味Current taste for this scene

记录只存在你自己的浏览器里。导出的文件交给命令行:node skills/design-taste/scripts/taste.mjs --style=inkwash import 文件。The log stays in your browser. Hand the export to node skills/design-taste/scripts/taste.mjs --style=inkwash import file.
